name: printer
description:
Print text, files, images, or canvas pages. Supports color printing and compact mode for smaller text.

Examples:
- 'Print this: Hello World' → action: print, text: Hello World
- 'Print in compact mode' → action: print, text: ..., compact: true
- 'Print my canvas' → action: print_canvas (auto-compact)
- 'Print this image' → action: print, file_path: /path/to/image.jpg
- 'Print in black and white' → color: false
- 'Is the printer ready?' → action: status

Canvas pages auto-use compact mode. Images auto-fit to page.

file_path.description: Path to file (text, PDF, or image: jpg/png/gif)

canvas_id.description: Canvas page ID or search term. Omit for most recent.

compact.description: Use smaller text for more content per page (default false, canvas auto-true)

color.description: Print in color (default true). Set false for grayscale.

quality.description: Print quality: Draft, Normal (default), or High
